name: Davis rich media (custom formulation, chemostat growth media) (PMC3977541)
description: Davis rich media (custom formulation, chemostat growth media), medium reported in PMC3977541, extracted for GrowthDB and mapped to BiGG.

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC3977541 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Composition mapped to BiGG (mapper + salt dissociation); presence-based bounds; paper_amount retained. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification_evidence: Media for all chemostat PACE experiments was prepared by autoclaving a 20 L carboy of MilliQ water containing a custom Davis rich media formulation: anhydrous K2HPO4 (140 g), KH2PO4 (40 g), (NH4)2SO4 (20 g), NaCl (58 g), casamino acids (100 g), Tween-80 (20 mL), L-cysteine (1 g), L-tryptophan (0.5 g), adenine (0.5 g), guanine (0.5 g), cytosine (0.5 g), uracil (0.5 g), CaCl2 (0.5 uM final). ... sup

Casamino acids.citation: Casamino acids = ACID hydrolysate of casein. Source: tryptophan destroyed by acid hydrolysis, cysteine low (Nolan & Smith 1962, J Biol Chem; BD Bionutrient Technical Manual).

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all divides components by (components + unresolved ingredients). It counts pipeline-derived components as covered, so it is not a measure of how much of the source's own ingredient list was captured. pct_covered_source divides source-stated components by (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components), which is that measure. Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
